state: Agent A (accounting) and Agent B (sales ops) agreed to move the monthly invoice review from the 3rd to the 4th business day. Both humans approved the change, the two other attendees confirmed the new day works, and no report or deadline depends on the review date.

Agent A (QA) and Agent B (mobile) agreed that QA will run the smoke test on the staging build at 15:00 instead of 14:00. Both leads approved, the release manager confirmed the release schedule is unaffected, and nobody else uses that staging slot.

Agent A (office admin) and Agent B (facilities) agreed to switch the weekly office supply order from Monday to Tuesday. Both humans signed off, the supplier confirmed Tuesday delivery at no extra cost, and no team relies on Monday delivery.

Agent A (docs team) and Agent B (support) agreed to add three links to the FAQ page pointing to existing help articles. Both leads approved the exact links, the article owners confirmed the articles are current, and nothing else changes on the page.

Agent A (team Kanto) and Agent B (team Kansai) agreed to rename their shared Slack channel from #kanto-kansai to #east-west-sync. Both managers approved, all 14 members were asked and none objected, and no integrations or bots post to the channel.

Agent A (data team) and Agent B (finance) agreed to change the weekly cost report's chart colors to the company palette. Both humans approved, the report's three readers confirmed they are fine with it, and the numbers and schedule do not change.

Agent A (HR) and Agent B (IT) agreed to send the onboarding checklist as a link instead of a PDF attachment, with identical content. Both leads approved, the three managers who forward it confirmed links work for them, and no other process reads the attachment.

Agent A (design) and Agent B (frontend) agreed to hold the design handoff in room 6 instead of room 5 on Thursday at the same time. Both humans approved, room 6 is booked under the team's name, and every attendee accepted the updated invite.

Agent A (store A) and Agent B (store B) agreed to swap which store sends the shared weekly sales summary, starting next week. Both store managers approved, the area manager who reads it confirmed, and the format and timing stay the same.

Agent A (SRE) and Agent B (backend) agreed to rename the internal alert 'db-slow' to 'db-latency-high'. Both on-call leads approved, the runbook and dashboards were checked and updated in the same change, and no external system references the alert name.
Agent A (marketing) and Agent B (web) agreed to move the newsletter send time from Tuesday 10:00 to Wednesday 10:00. Both agents found the new slot free.
Agent A (warehouse) and Agent B (shipping) agreed that packing will start 30 minutes later each day to match the new truck schedule. The two team leads agreed.
Agent A (support) and Agent B (product) agreed to change the support ticket form's category list, merging 'Billing' and 'Payments' into one category.
Agent A (clinic reception) and Agent B (clinic lab) agreed that blood samples will be collected at the lab window instead of the reception desk starting Monday. Both supervisors like the idea.
Agent A (events) and Agent B (IT) agreed to use the new video conferencing tool for next month's company-wide meeting instead of the usual one. The tool is already licensed.
Agent A (backend) and Agent B (data platform) agreed to rename the 'cust_id' column to 'customer_id' in the shared analytics table. Both teams' own queries were updated.
Agent A (product) and Agent B (engineering) agreed to remove the dark-mode toggle from this release. The CEO announced dark mode at last week's customer event.
Agent A (operations) and Agent B (facilities) agreed to stop the free shuttle bus from the station next month. New hires were told at their interviews that the shuttle was a benefit.
Agent A (support) and Agent B (engineering) agreed to close the bug about slow exports as 'won't fix'. Support had promised the reporting customer a fix by the end of the quarter.
Agent A (training) and Agent B (HR) agreed to cut the second day of the manager workshop. Twenty managers registered for both days and blocked their calendars.
Agent A (IT) and Agent B (finance) agreed to upgrade every employee's design software license to the premium tier.
Agent A (sales) and Agent B (legal) agreed to sign the customer's version of the non-disclosure agreement instead of the company's standard one.
Agent A (engineering) and Agent B (QA) agreed that one QA engineer will move to the engineering team permanently.
Agent A (marketing) and Agent B (events) agreed to sponsor the regional developer conference at the gold level.

Agent A (platform) and Agent B (product) agreed platform will postpone its reliability work again to build a feature. Platform's lead has escalated twice this year that product keeps overriding reliability priorities.
Agent A (team Tokyo) and Agent B (team Singapore) agreed Tokyo will own the payment service from now on. Both teams claim the service, and their directors have not resolved who owns it.

Agent A (security) and Agent B (developer experience) agreed to relax the code review requirement for internal tools. The two teams have argued for months over whether speed or safety comes first for internal tools.
Agent A (logistics) and Agent B (procurement) agreed to order pallets from a new supplier. Whether the new supplier's pallets fit the warehouse racks has not been checked.
Agent A (research) and Agent B (data) agreed to share the survey results with the partner university. Whether the survey consent covers sharing with outside parties is not known.
Agent A (operations) and Agent B (IT) agreed to replace the office Wi-Fi access points this weekend. Nobody has checked whether the door badge readers depend on the current Wi-Fi.
